fire: According to the textbook, gravitational waves are ripples in the geometry of the universe.

Simply put, gravitational waves are ripples moving through spacetime at light speed.
Astronomers explain that gravitational waves are ripples left by colliding stars.
In plain words, gravitational waves are ripples in space itself.

Like light, gravitational waves are ripples that carry energy across the sky.
